prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a final ROUND 2 Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 1536x1024 approximately 3:2, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel blocks, skilled human builder quality, plain warm light background, no characters or animals. Reference image 1 is the mood board; reference image 2 is the prior concept to refine; reference image 3 is the actual immutable site and numbered plan.

Two main views SIDE BY SIDE: LEFT straight-on orthographic NORTH FRONT ELEVATION of ONE complete sample row, all eight modules 0 through 7 in order; RIGHT three-quarter southeast view looking uphill west with all eight same buildings placed on the EXACT terraces and pads in reference 3. Same block scale in both views. Use lower strip for small readable cutaway details of slab access, family loft, gin machinery bay, and wall-integrated flue. Prioritize buildings over large title. Title "POLARTON / HILLSIDE KIT — ROUND 2". Small labels identify modules unambiguously.

Correct three prior weaknesses: erroneous site labels/placement; stair stoops instead of accessible slab approaches; generic work sheds lacking visible purpose. Preserve successful dark slate gin roof, pale school, brown farmhouse, open smith frontage, white steepled church, tall tobacco barn, slatted crib and green copper brick owner's house; strengthen framed openings, recessed windows, proud beams, eaves, verges and ridges.

EXACT GRID for left row: dirt/gravel lane x0..95 z0..4. Each plot i x12*i..12*i+11, z5..18, twelve wide fourteen deep. Nothing including eaves, chimney or porch crosses its plot. Identical spruce_fence perimeter, centered two-wide spruce_fence_gate x12*i+5..6, lantern posts at both front corners. Front yard z5..8. Every front faces north. Low ground floors maximum one block above yard. Approaches use ONLY bottom slabs rising half-block increments, no stair blocks on entrance paths; at most three increments then >=2x2 flat landing, final cell flush before door. Show slab-slab approach and landing clearly.

0 COTTON GIN: two storeys, mustard stripped_spruce_log and birch_planks timber walls, deepslate slate roof, wide front wagon opening, loft hoist beam and open hay door. Clear machine bay reserved for owner's Create gin, NO mod blocks depicted, marked floor shaft opening and aligned wall shaft opening.
1 SCHOOL: one room white_concrete clapboard interpretation, slate gable, small bell cupola, cloakroom porch, yard bench, cartography_table.
2 FARMHOUSE: one and half storeys birch_planks with spruce timber, brown shingle spruce_stairs roof, deep porch, rear kitchen ell. Four complete family beds upstairs.
3 BLACKSMITH/WHEELWRIGHT: open front forge shed, timber framing, slate roof with separate lean-to sheltering block-built cart, own masonry chimney, anvil, smithing_table, wheel in progress built with vanilla trapdoors/fences.
4 CHURCH: white_concrete and calcite, slender high steeple with slate spire, lectern by entry, small graveyard enclosed with birch_fence pickets entirely INSIDE outer spruce perimeter.
5 TOBACCO BARN: tall narrow spruce vertical boards, visible vent gaps, open doors show multiple hanging tobacco tiers represented by vanilla leaf/vine blocks, controlled base hearth/flue.
6 CORN CRIB + GRANARY: distinctly slatted spruce crib raised on stone piers, adjacent enclosed granary, slab ramp, sacks represented by birch blocks and barrels, fence-and-chain scale.
7 OWNER'S HOUSE: two storeys bricks, calcite porch columns and trim, oxidized_copper roof, wraparound porch within plot, projecting bay and downhill balcony; four family beds upstairs.

RIGHT SITE: preserve reference 3 landform, existing spruce fences, orange/gravel streets, stepped retaining walls, bridges, stream on east/right and existing village roofs; DO NOT invent or flatten terraces. Map sample module to SITE NUMBER exactly: 0 on site1 lower east by village faces north; 1 on site2 upper plateau faces west; 2 on site3 upper western pad faces east; 3 on site4 eastern stream pad faces south; 4 on site5 highest western plateau pad faces east; 5 on site6 southern flat pad faces north; 6 on site7 southern flat pad faces north; 7 on site8 plateau edge faces west. Label with "site 1 / gin", "site 2 / school", etc rather than wrong module numbers. No buildings on small K/F/P pads. Keep existing village buildings.

Detail strip: cutaway living floor and loft for farmhouse and owner's house with 3-4 WHOLE beds per house, bed heads against solid walls, no windows behind heads, two blocks clear above, reachable from door, stairs inside finish flush at upper floor. Table, stove beside hearth, composter at farmhouse. Chimney section: campfire at BOTTOM, hay_block hidden directly beneath floor, 1x1 air flue enclosed on all four sides, integrated into exterior wall or partition, constant-width masonry passing through roof, roof stops against stack, open mouth 1-2 courses above roof, NO crown, entirely inside plot. Lantern lighting throughout.

Exact palette from swatches: stripped_spruce_log, birch_planks, white_concrete, bricks, spruce_planks, calcite, oxidized_copper_stairs, deepslate_tile_stairs, glass_pane, spruce_fence, spruce_fence_gate, lantern. Required valid shape variants: spruce_stairs, spruce_slab, spruce_trapdoor, spruce_door, birch_stairs, birch_slab, birch_fence, brick_stairs, brick_slab, brick_wall, deepslate_tiles, deepslate_tile_slab, deepslate_tile_wall, oxidized_copper, oxidized_copper_slab, cobblestone, cobblestone_stairs, cobblestone_slab, cobblestone_wall. Natural grass_block, dirt, gravel, oak_leaves, cherry_leaves, water remain site materials. No invented smooth curves, no photorealism. Render genuine chunky stair/slab/trapdoor construction, readable roof edges and lived-in details. Small palette strip, minimal text, clear architectural presentation.

roles.role: Timber walls, framing, floors, porches and furnishings

changes: Generated with the built-in image tool and saved unchanged as concept-2.png in the current directory.

Biggest prior shortfall 1: site numbering and placement. The new sheet improves building identification, but inspection still finds incorrect labels and placement: school is labeled site 1, farmhouse site 2, owner’s house site 7, and crib site 8. Exact site compliance remains unresolved.

Biggest prior shortfall 2: entrance stair stoops. Added a dedicated slab-access detail and lower entrance approaches, although several rendered entrances still read as stairs; the image does not establish compliance with every slab and landing dimension.

Biggest prior shortfall 3: generic working buildings. Added a gin machine-bay close-up showing the hoist and floor opening, and strengthened the open forge, vented tobacco frontage and raised slatted crib. Several required work props remain unclear.
Retained the successful roof colors, white church steeple, brick owner’s house, timber framing, recessed openings and deep porches.

Added four-bed family-floor views and a clearer wall-integrated chimney section. Bed-head wall backing, headroom, stair termination and enclosed flue geometry still require checking during construction.

The palette uses valid oxidized_cut_copper_stairs and oxidized_cut_copper_slab ids; the prompt inherited the mood board’s invalid shortened copper shape names. The rendered site also changes terrain details, so it remains concept art rather than an exact placement plan.
